# The Conversation

> In-depth analysis, research, news and ideas from leading academics and researchers.

The Conversation is a global nonprofit news platform where professional editors work with scholars and researchers to publish evidence-based journalism. It offers regional editions, topic hubs, podcasts, and multilingual coverage spanning politics, health, science, culture, education, business, and the environment.

## Main Edition

- [Home](https://theconversation.com/ca/home-page): Canadian homepage featuring the latest expert analysis, research-based news, and editor-curated stories.
- [Podcasts](https://theconversation.com/ca/podcasts): Audio journalism and podcast episodes exploring current events, research, and public-interest issues.
- [En français](https://theconversation.com/ca-fr): French-language Canadian edition with expert commentary and research-based reporting.
- [Donate](https://donate.theconversation.com/ca?utm_source=theconversation.com&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=mobile-menu): Support page for contributing to The Conversation’s nonprofit public-interest journalism.

## Topic Sections

- [Arts](https://theconversation.com/ca/arts): Expert analysis on literature, film, music, visual culture, and creative industries.
- [Business + Economy](https://theconversation.com/ca/business): Research-backed coverage of markets, work, public policy, trade, and economic trends.
- [Culture + Society](https://theconversation.com/ca/culture): Commentary on social change, communities, identity, media, and everyday life.
- [Education](https://theconversation.com/ca/education): Reporting and analysis on schools, universities, teaching, learning, and education policy.
- [Environment + Energy](https://theconversation.com/ca/environment): Coverage of climate, biodiversity, conservation, sustainability, and energy systems.
- [Health](https://theconversation.com/ca/health): Evidence-based articles on medicine, public health, mental health, and healthcare systems.
- [Politics](https://theconversation.com/ca/politics): Academic perspectives on elections, governance, law, public institutions, and policy debates.
- [Science + Tech](https://theconversation.com/ca/technology): Research news and analysis on science, innovation, digital technology, and discovery.

## Regional Editions

- [Africa](https://theconversation.com/africa): Regional edition covering African politics, society, health, education, and development issues.
- [Australia](https://theconversation.com/au): Australian edition with expert reporting on national affairs, science, and public policy.
- [Brasil](https://theconversation.com/br): Brazilian edition publishing research-informed journalism in Portuguese.
- [Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca): English-language Canadian edition focused on national and global issues.
- [Canada (français)](https://theconversation.com/ca-fr): French-language Canadian edition for readers seeking analysis in French.
- [Català](https://theconversation.com/catalan): Catalan-language edition featuring expert commentary and public-interest journalism.
- [España](https://theconversation.com/es): Spanish edition covering Spain and broader international topics.
- [Europe](https://theconversation.com/europe): European edition with analysis of regional politics, society, science, and policy.

## Core Coverage Areas

- [Arts in Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca/arts): Canadian arts and humanities coverage from scholars and cultural experts.
- [Business in Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca/business): Canadian business, labour, finance, and economic policy reporting.
- [Culture in Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca/culture): Canadian society, identity, media, and social issues explained by researchers.
- [Education in Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca/education): Canadian education news spanning K–12, higher education, and pedagogy.
- [Environment in Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca/environment): Canadian reporting on climate policy, ecosystems, energy, and environmental science.
- [Health in Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca/health): Canadian health reporting on care systems, disease, wellness, and medical research.
- [Politics in Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca/politics): Canadian politics coverage on elections, institutions, legislation, and public affairs.
- [Technology in Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca/technology): Canadian science and technology stories on innovation, AI, research, and digital life.

## Audio

- [Canadian Podcasts](https://theconversation.com/ca/podcasts): Podcast hub for Canadian audio stories, interviews, and expert explainers.
- [Australia Podcasts](https://theconversation.com/au/podcasts): Australian podcast collection featuring research-led discussions and current affairs.
- [Africa Podcasts](https://theconversation.com/africa/podcasts): Audio coverage focused on African issues, ideas, and expert perspectives.

## Language Editions

- [English Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca): English-language Canadian site for expert journalism and analysis.
- [Français Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca-fr): French-language Canadian site with translated and original reporting.
- [Português Brasil](https://theconversation.com/br): Portuguese-language Brazilian edition of The Conversation.
- [Català](https://theconversation.com/catalan): Catalan-language publication for regional and international analysis.
- [Español](https://theconversation.com/es): Spanish-language edition with expert reporting and commentary.

## About and Support

- [The Conversation Canada Home](https://theconversation.com/ca/home-page): Entry point to the Canadian edition and its latest featured stories.
- [Donate to The Conversation Canada](https://donate.theconversation.com/ca?utm_source=theconversation.com&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=mobile-menu): Donation page supporting independent, nonprofit explanatory journalism.
- [The Conversation Global Site](https://theconversation.com): Global homepage connecting readers to editions and major stories worldwide.
